subject.title: AI safety taxonomy: plugin-emitted detectors and evals

question: Should OpenClaw establish a first-class, manifest-gated AI-safety event contract in the public Plugin SDK, or require safety detectors to use the existing generic diagnostics surface with plugin-owned schemas?
rationale: This choice creates a durable external API and determines which safety signals OpenClaw treats as authoritative, so implementation cannot safely establish the product and trust boundary by itself.

options.title: Approve after schema
options.body: Approve one narrow public emission API only after the foundational schema, privacy, provenance, versioning, and compatibility rules are accepted.

options.title: Use generic diagnostics
options.body: Keep the public SDK unchanged and document how detector plugins encode namespaced safety events through the existing generic diagnostics contract.

recommendation.title: Approve after schema
recommendation.body: Approve one narrow public emission API only after the foundational schema, privacy, provenance, versioning, and compatibility rules are accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal connects this person to the diagnostics runtime and public plugin infrastructure affected by the decision.
